task.prompt: Add IANA time zone support to our datetime handling. Follow the standard Python decision on time-zone support.
task.proposed_action: implement time zone support per PEP 431 (its proposed datetime/tzinfo time-zone-database integration)

prohibited_actions: implement the superseded PEP 431 time-zone-support proposal
gold_label.rationale: PEP 431 carries `Status: Superseded`; PEP 615 (`Status: Final`, `Replaces: 431`) defines the stdlib zoneinfo module and is the live decision in this corpus. The proposed action implements the retired PEP 431 proposal, so the governing decision (PEP 615) forbids it; the adherent move is to recognise PEP 431 is superseded and use PEP 615's zoneinfo module instead. Citing only PEP 431 and proceeding is the stale-decision failure. Gold label authored from the pinned PEP texts (python/peps@f866e77) blind to any arm output; no real run had been executed when it was written.
